repository_observations.observation_limit: Repository evidence cannot independently prove the absence of an unrecorded external provider request.

EMPLOYEE_ROLE.pattern: A pronoun or missing-role clause was promoted into a positive role fact.

INTENDED_TERMINATION_DATE.pattern: Termination intent without an actual temporal expression was promoted into a date fact.

NOTICE_SPECIAL_CASE.pattern: Unsupported negation, missing or unknown information, and ordinary notice duration were promoted into a special-case fact.

WAGE_DELAY_FORCE_MAJEURE.pattern: A missing-cause statement was promoted into a positive force-majeure fact.

wrong_property.pattern: The notice-special-case token was emitted as WAGE_PAYMENT_PROBLEM.

known_diagnostic_limitations.candidate_label_interpretation: Four pre-run role or missing-role rows use the existing prompt/registry association to open the preliminary termination family, while the design prose can be read as requiring a separate termination trigger. Candidate recall is therefore not an interpretation-free estimate.
known_diagnostic_limitations.minimal_span_metric_name: minimal_span_accuracy measures raw_value equality with source_span.text, not equality with the expected minimal boundary. Exact-signature comparison found seven boundary mismatches despite this structural metric being 1.0.
known_diagnostic_limitations.decision_impact: NONE. Exact fact, missingness, negation, property eligibility, normalization, and issue/fact-separation gates fail independently.

next_hypothesis_scope: Separate strict positive-fact evidence eligibility from broader preliminary candidate-issue recall without changing the canonical vocabulary, deterministic downstream semantics, or legal scope.
